text:
Anya: Quick sync — I put a short recruitment brief in the sheet (link). Need sign-off on: commitment letter, incentives, onboarding hooks, and feedback cadence. Outreach planned tomorrow morning.
Mike: Saw it. Two quick asks: 1) make the onboarding checklist explicit with 3 mandatory touchpoints, 2) cap the pilot cohort to 8 active partners so SEs can support.
Anya: Agreed on 8. Also thinking of a small stipend + usage credits for feedback deliverables.
Sara: For research cadence I'd recommend a lightweight diary (daily short form) + one 30m weekly interview. That gives both quantitative signal and qualitative color.
Devraj: I can draft an "integration readiness" checklist for SE handoff — calls to action for infra, sample data, test prompts, and latency SLA expectations. Will paste snippets below.
Julia: Legal note: we should use a short NDA + a minimal SOW that clarifies data handling, retention, and allowed uses. I'll propose a one‑page NDA and a 1-paragraph SOW.
Mike: Also add rollback criteria: if model quality drops >10% on our eval set or latency regresses >50ms for 3 consecutive days, automatic fallback to baseline model.
Anya: Good. We should include success criteria that are measurable: weekly active sessions, qualitative CS score, and eval-regression threshold.
Devraj: Paste: ```
# Integration readiness checklist (SE)
- Confirm network/VPC access or example curl endpoint
- Provide 3 sample prompt flows + expected outcomes
- Define max seq length / KV-cache hints
- Test payload size and batch size expectations
- Contact person + hours for urgent triage
``` 
Sara: Paste: ```
# Feedback cadence & deliverables
- Daily diary (2-3 quick fields): task, success (y/n), weird outputs
- Weekly 30m interview (recorded, consented)
- Two eval runs (week 0, week 4) on locked prompt set
- Post-pilot retrospective + short survey (5 Qs) for NPS-like signal
``` 
Anya: Draft commitment letter (short) — please review: ```
Dear Partner,
Thanks for joining Redwood pilot. Commitment: use the integration for x weeks, complete weekly feedback interviews, and run us through your main prompt flows. In exchange: priority support, credits up to $X, and early access to features. Cancellation: 2-week notice.
``` 
Julia: Edits: add data clause: "We will only store outputs for eval purposes; customer data remains customer-owned; we will not train on customer data without explicit consent." Happy to send redline.
Mike: Metrics we will track (proposal): activation rate (first two weeks), weekly active prompts per partner, median latency P95, eval-regression delta, number of actionable bugs reported.
Anya: Outreach message needs soft CTA + explicit time commitment line. Also add opt-in checkbox for case studies.
Sara: For incentivizing high-quality feedback consider "pay-per-feedback-credit" — small $50 per finished interview or credits that unlock features.
Devraj: SE handoff script (short): "Intro call -> deploy smoke test -> run 3 shared prompts -> confirm metrics dashboard -> weekly triage slot." I'll post a short template.
onboard-bot: Reminder: outreach template scheduled for 2025-06-15 09:00 PT. Use channel #product-outreach for sending.
Mike: Can someone assemble the final packet (recruitment brief + commitment + onboarding checklist + outreach template) before 09:00 today?
Anya: I'll assemble and tag folks. If Julia and Devraj can finalize legal and SE snippets by 12:00 that would be perfect. Thanks :thumbsup: 
Julia: Will do — I'll push NDA + SOW redline to the doc by 11:30.
Devraj: SE snippets in the doc by 11:45. I'll include a short runbook for post-signup triage.
Sara: I'll add the diary template and the week 0/week 4 eval rubric by noon.
Mike: Great. Quick follow-up: we should explicitly list the top 3 risks for partners (time commitment, integration effort, data handling) and the mitigations. Add to final packet.
Anya: Will add risk/mitigation section. Final note: prefer concise language, single-page commitment, and one onboarding checklist per partner. Thanks everyone.
